BasicErrorResponseV1.description: The error body of every UI API operation (core and extensions).

error.description: The error message (the same as message; kept for clients of UI API 1.0 to 1.5).

code.description:
A stable, machine-readable code. Well-known values: BAD_REQUEST (400), UNAUTHENTICATED (401),
PERMISSION_DENIED (403), NOT_FOUND (404), CONFLICT (409), RATE_LIMITED (429), INTERNAL_ERROR (500),
ERROR (other). Extensions may add codes; treat an unknown code by the HTTP status. Since 1.6.0.

message.description: A message to show the user. Since 1.6.0.

fieldErrors.description: Errors about particular request fields, when known. Since 1.6.0.

code.description: An optional machine-readable code, e.g. REQUIRED, TOO_LONG, PATTERN.

traceId.description: Identifies this request in the server logs (also the X-QQQ-Trace-Id response header); quote it when reporting a problem. Since 1.6.0.

sessionUuidCookie.description: The session cookie set by POST /qqq/v1/manageSession (web clients).
sessionUuidCookie.name: sessionUUID

bearerAuth.description:
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is either
- an OAuth2 access token (a signed JWT) issued by the app's identity provider to the app's client,
  or to its native client (`values.nativeClientId` in GET /qqq/v1/metaData/authentication), for
  example from the device-authorization grant or auth-code + PKCE. It is verified against the
  provider's keys (issuer, audience, expiry, signature) and gives the same user and permissions
  as signing in on the web. When it expires (401), refresh it at the provider and retry; or
- a session UUID returned by POST /qqq/v1/manageSession, which the server keeps refreshed.

oauth2.description:
The app's OAuth2 / OpenID Connect provider. The real endpoints come from the provider's discovery
document: `{values.baseUrl}.well-known/openid-configuration`, with values from
GET /qqq/v1/metaData/authentication. Native clients use `values.nativeClientId` (a public client)
with auth-code + PKCE (loopback or custom-scheme redirect URI registered at the provider) or the
device-authorization grant (`device_authorization_endpoint`, RFC 8628), then send the access token
as `Authorization: Bearer`.

scopes.offline_access: A refresh token, to renew the access token without signing in again
scopes.profile: Name, username and groups (permissions come from the groups)

info.description: Authenticated retained delivery and durable server-write receipts
info.title: QQQ Middleware API extension: record-files-downloads

get.description: Authenticated exact retained version; durable attempt precedes bytes. Completion observes server writes, never browser persistence.

400.description: Bad request: a parameter or the body is invalid (code BAD_REQUEST); fieldErrors may name the fields.

401.description: Not authenticated, or the session or token is invalid or expired (code UNAUTHENTICATED). Sign in again, or refresh the token.

403.description: The user (or the credential's scope) may not do this (code PERMISSION_DENIED).

404.description: Not found, or not visible to this user (code NOT_FOUND).

409.description: Conflict with the current state, e.g. an edit conflict or an invalid transition (code CONFLICT).

429.description: Too many requests (code RATE_LIMITED); retry later.
